# AI Consulting Firms

> Shortlist ten AI consulting firms for an RFP. Compare bid evidence, named staff, contract scope and what each finalist must demonstrate.

Published by AY Automate, a seller of AI implementation services. [Editorial policy and corrections](https://theaiconsultingfirms.com/#editorial).

## Guide
- [AI consulting firms: build a defensible RFP shortlist](https://theaiconsultingfirms.com/)
- [Score AI consulting firms from the same RFP](https://theaiconsultingfirms.com/worksheet/)
- [An AI RFP template with a worked scoring example](https://theaiconsultingfirms.com/ai-rfp-template/)

## Provider sources
- [Accenture](https://www.accenture.com/en-us/support/state-texas-accenture-dir-artificial-intelligence): Enterprise delivery. Publishes an AI services offering under the Texas DIR contract. Request the proposed statement of work and ask the bidder to map each mandatory requirement to its contract clause.
- [BCG](https://www.bcg.com/capabilities/artificial-intelligence): Enterprise transformation. Combines strategy and applied AI. Ask which executive sponsor and delivery lead would answer an escalation. Score the named team attending the bid review.
- [Capgemini](https://www.capgemini.com/news/client-stories/zf-friedrichshafen-establishes-a-global-rpa-service-in-a-single-year/): Process automation. Documents the rollout of a global robotic process automation service at ZF. Request a reference for a program spanning multiple business units and ask what the client had to supply during rollout.
- [Deloitte](https://www.deloitte.com/global/en/services/consulting/services/engineering-ai-data.html): Engineering and data. Groups engineering, AI and data delivery in one practice. Give the bid team a sample data-quality exception. Score the proposed ownership and cost of remediation.
- [IBM Consulting](https://www.ibm.com/consulting/artificial-intelligence): Technology integration. Offers artificial intelligence consulting. Request the responsibilities of the consulting team and software partners separately, including the support boundary.
- [McKinsey QuantumBlack](https://www.mckinsey.com/capabilities/quantumblack/our-approach): Analytics and operating model. Describes a hybrid intelligence approach. Have the bid team show how an operations owner can challenge a model recommendation and record the ruling.
- [Slalom](https://www.slalom.com/us/en/services/artificial-intelligence): AI implementation. Describes AI consulting for enterprise teams. Ask for the rollout lead to attend the reference interview. Compare promised training with what the named client received.
- [WeAreBrain](https://wearebrain.com/ai-automation-agency/): Workflow integration. Offers workflow automation and integration. Require a responsibility table for the agency and its ERP partner. Ask who handles incidents spanning both systems.
- [LowCode Agency](https://www.lowcode.agency/blog/ai-workflow-automation): Low-code delivery. Publishes a guide to AI agents that run business processes. For a low-code bid, request export rights, platform fees and access rules in the same commercial response.
- [Goodspeed](https://goodspeed.studio/n8n-agency): Operations workflows. Describes n8n workflows and AI agents for operations teams. Which past project matches our scope, and who owned delivery and handover?
- [Remote MCP](https://theaiconsultingfirms.com/mcp): search_firms, compare_firms and recommend_providers.
